items.exampleEn: Is it safe to swim here?
I buy fresh vegetables every morning.
items.exampleZh: 我每天早上買新鮮的蔬菜。

items.exampleEn: The original plan was to leave at eight.
items.exampleZh: 原本的計畫是八點出發。

items.exampleEn: You need basic computer skills for this job.
items.exampleZh: 這份工作需要基本的電腦技能。

items.exampleEn: The old bridge is a famous feature of this town.
items.exampleZh: 這座舊橋是這個小鎮有名的特色。

items.exampleEn: The list is not complete yet.
You can easily find it online.
items.exampleZh: 你在網路上很容易就能找到。

items.sentenceEn: The fish at this market is always fresh.
items.sentenceZh: 這個市場的魚總是很新鮮。

items.audioEn: The hotel is perfect: it's safe, clean and close to the beach.
items.audioZh: 那家旅館很完美：安全、乾淨，又離海邊很近。
items.questionZh: 說話的人覺得那家旅館怎麼樣？
options: It is far from the beach

items.sentenceEn: This plan is perfect for us.
items.sentenceZh: 這個計畫對我們來說再適合不過了。
我們的團隊現在人員齊全了。

items.stemEn: Keep your money in a ____ place.
items.stemZh: 把你的錢放在安全的地方。

items.stemEn: The ____ plan was to go by train, but we drove instead.
items.stemZh: 原本的計畫是搭火車，但我們後來改開車。

items.passageEn: Linda opened a small restaurant last year. Her original idea was simple: serve basic home cooking made with fresh vegetables. The restaurant has one special feature. The kitchen is open, so customers can easily watch the cooks at work. Everything is clean and safe. "It's not perfect yet," Linda says, "but I am very happy with it."
items.passageZh: Linda 去年開了一家小餐廳。她最初的想法很簡單：用新鮮蔬菜做基本的家常菜。這家餐廳有一個特色：廚房是開放式的，客人可以輕鬆看到廚師工作的樣子。一切都乾淨又安全。Linda 說：「還不算完美，但我對它很滿意。」

questions.questionZh: Linda 開餐廳最初的想法是什麼？
options: 用昂貴食材做高級的西式料理
用新鮮蔬菜做簡單的家常菜

items.promptZh: 這間公寓很適合我們家。
referenceEn: This apartment is perfect for our family.
This apartment is perfect for us.
rubricZh: 「很適合」可寫例如 perfect for、great for、just right for
主詞與動詞要搭配（例如 This apartment is）

items.promptZh: 我們很輕鬆就贏了那場比賽。
rubricZh: 用 easily 表示「輕鬆地」，可放動詞前或句尾（例如 easily won、won the game easily 等）
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 won、have won 等）
